source: Curiosity REMS daily air temperature record, NASA Mars / Centro de Astrobiologia (CSIC-INTA): https://mars.nasa.gov/rss/api/?feed=weather&category=msl&feedtype=json (sols 1-4995)
sensor: REMS air temperature sensor on Curiosity's mast (about 1.6 m above the ground)
note: Each season's daily low and high are MEASURED averages from Curiosity's record. The hours in between follow a typical daily shape and are approximate (the record has no hourly values). Suit thermal limits are not modeled.

northern_spring_summer.description: Cooler half of the year at Gale Crater (southern autumn and winter; Mars is farthest from the Sun near Ls 71).

northern_autumn_winter.description: Warmer half of the year at Gale Crater (southern spring and summer; Mars is closest to the Sun near Ls 251).
